data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for haptic feedback with consistent patterns across iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides standard haptic feedback effects like success, warning, error, light, medium, heavy, and selection. It utilizes iOS haptics natively and emulates similar patterns on Android.
use_when: You want consistent haptic feedback patterns across both iOS and Android platforms.
You need standard UI feedback types like button taps, selections, and success or error alerts.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
You require complex custom continuous vibration waveforms outside the predefined haptic types.
strengths: Cross-platform consistency emulating iOS haptic patterns on Android.
Supports iOS preparation APIs to reduce initial latency.
Catches native platform exceptions to prevent app crashes.
weaknesses: Advanced Android haptic primitives and features require newer Android API levels.
data.setup_notes: Automatically includes the VIBRATE permission in the merged AndroidManifest.xml. No manual configuration required for basic use.

alternatives.name: vibration
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose vibration if you need low-level timing and custom vibration patterns rather than high-level standardized haptic feedback types.

data.minimal_example:
final canVibrate = await Haptics.canVibrate();
await Haptics.vibrate(HapticsType.success);
